name: dossier
displayName: Dossier (Job Search · Story Bank · Tailored Applications)
description: An opinionated job-search workflow for Claude Code. An extensive resumable interview records the candidate's career as a story bank and builds one superset CV — the exemplar — verified for containment against the bank and signed off by the candidate, once. Every application then trims that signed exemplar byte-verbatim and argues from the same evidence in a fresh cover letter, at two LLM dispatches per posting with deterministic scripts in between. Ships European/DACH market conventions. No commit hook — enforcement is the single verifier gate plus the superset invariant. The plugin contains zero personal data; both artifacts live in the user's own job folder.
